# WO-216: Review card in Windows forced-colors mode
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-049)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: test-quality
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Source: CP-47 (docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md), accepted as proposed

## Goal / acceptance criteria
Exactly as written in CP-47: emulate `forced_colors="active"` with the existing offline Chromium/app fixtures and fake data; all three review-card actions stay distinguishable and keyboard usable, focus has a visible system-color indicator, text stays legible, Yes/No feedback stays available, and no seeded listing values are shown. State that Chromium emulation does not replace a real Windows High Contrast check. Tests only; report source defects as findings with file:line.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_forced_colors.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_forced_colors.py tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_a11y.py tests/test_wizard_review_match.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex`
